content_en.title: Islamic School Website & Online Admissions
content_en.summary: A redesign for an integrated Islamic school running playgroup, kindergarten, primary, junior and senior high on one campus. Parents compare levels and fees, register and upload documents from their phone, follow observation dates and results in a parent portal, and pay re-enrolment online; the admissions team works from a board with seat quotas.
content_en.challenge:
The old site opened with a pop-up poster and a long block of text. Registration went through a generic online form linked from a link-in-bio page, so parents could not see which documents were missing, when the test was, or when results would come out. No fees were published at all, so every cost question moved to WhatsApp.

Programs for the four levels were spread over separate profile pages dominated by vision and mission statements, the gallery was mostly text-heavy banners and group photos of children, and the FAQ answers were cut off.
content_en.solution:
The homepage answers what parents ask first: each level with ages, hours, Qur'an memorisation targets and programs, what happens every school day, campus facilities, a fee table that switches between the first-wave price and the normal price, the five admission steps, an agenda and an FAQ. Admission runs as numbered steps with a registration number, document uploads from a phone with a progress bar, and a summary that applies the first-wave and sibling discounts.

The parent portal handles more than one child: an acceptance notice with the decision letter, the registration journey, a date strip with observation, interview and deadline markers, and a checkout for re-enrolment with full payment, three instalments or a pay-once-until-graduation option through virtual account or QRIS. Staff work from a board that moves applicants from missing documents to paid, with seat quotas per level and gender. The planned production stack is Laravel with MySQL, a VA/QRIS payment gateway and WhatsApp notifications.
features: Level cards with ages, hours, memorisation targets and programs
Fee table with first-wave and normal pricing
Step-by-step online admission with registration number
Document upload from phone with progress and verification
Parent portal for several children with schedule and results
Re-enrolment checkout: full, 3 instalments or pay once until graduation
Admissions board with seat quotas per level

content_id.title: Website Sekolah Islam & PPDB Online
content_id.summary: Redesign untuk sekolah Islam terpadu dengan unit KB, TK, SD, SMP, dan SMA dalam satu kampus. Orang tua membandingkan jenjang dan biaya, mendaftar dan mengunggah dokumen dari HP, memantau jadwal observasi dan pengumuman di portal orang tua, lalu membayar daftar ulang secara online; tim PPDB bekerja dari papan dengan kuota kursi.
content_id.challenge:
Situs lama dibuka dengan popup poster dan blok teks panjang. Pendaftaran lewat formulir online umum yang ditautkan dari halaman link-in-bio, sehingga orang tua tidak bisa melihat dokumen yang kurang, jadwal tes, atau kapan pengumuman keluar. Tidak ada satu pun informasi biaya, sehingga semua pertanyaan biaya pindah ke WhatsApp.

Program empat jenjang tersebar di halaman profil terpisah yang didominasi visi dan misi, galeri berisi banner penuh teks dan foto kelompok anak, dan jawaban FAQ terpotong.
content_id.solution:
Beranda menjawab pertanyaan pertama orang tua: setiap jenjang dengan usia, jam belajar, target hafalan, dan program; kegiatan harian; fasilitas kampus; tabel biaya yang bisa beralih antara harga gelombang 1 dan harga normal; lima langkah PPDB; agenda; dan FAQ. Pendaftaran berjalan per langkah dengan nomor pendaftaran, unggah dokumen dari HP dengan progress, dan ringkasan yang menghitung potongan gelombang 1 dan potongan saudara.

Portal orang tua mendukung lebih dari satu anak: pengumuman diterima dengan surat keputusan, perjalanan pendaftaran, deret tanggal dengan penanda observasi, wawancara, dan tenggat, serta checkout daftar ulang dengan pilihan lunas, cicil 3×, atau sekali bayar hingga lulus lewat VA atau QRIS. Staf bekerja dari papan yang memindahkan pendaftar dari dokumen kurang sampai lunas, dengan kuota kursi per jenjang dan per putra/putri. Stack produksi yang direncanakan adalah Laravel dengan MySQL, payment gateway VA/QRIS, dan notifikasi WhatsApp.
features: Kartu jenjang dengan usia, jam belajar, target hafalan, dan program
Tabel biaya harga gelombang 1 dan harga normal
PPDB online bertahap dengan nomor pendaftaran
Unggah dokumen dari HP dengan progress dan verifikasi
Portal orang tua untuk beberapa anak, berisi jadwal dan hasil
Checkout daftar ulang: lunas, cicil 3×, atau sekali hingga lulus
Papan PPDB dengan kuota kursi per jenjang
